seed_note: Fixed seed (today's date, 2026-09-24) used for shuffling group_keys before split assignment. Re-running the generator with this seed reproduces an identical split.
grouping_method: Every case carries a group_key (usually a drug/target/disease topic tag, e.g. 'pembro_melanoma_multi'). Cases that are near-paraphrases or that reuse the same drug+condition+category combination are given a shared group_key. Splitting is done by randomly shuffling the list of DISTINCT group_keys (not individual cases) with the fixed seed above, then assigning the first 60% of groups to development, the next 20% to validation, and the remainder to phase3_heldout. Every case belonging to a group is placed in that group's split -- no group is ever split across development/validation/phase3_heldout, which prevents template/topic leakage (e.g. a PubMed-only and a multi-source case about the same drug+disease combination always land in the same split).
gold_label_process: Every case's gold label (required/permitted sources, operation, required/optional parameters, abstention expectation, and gold_query_must_contain_concepts for free-text PubMed queries) was authored by directly inspecting the real tool method signatures (tools/pubmed_tool.py, tools/clinical_trials_tool.py, tools/chembl_tool.py), the typed argument schemas in orchestration/models.py (PubMedSearchArgs, ClinicalTrialsSearchArgs, ChEMBLSearchByTargetArgs, ChEMBLSearchByIndicationArgs, ChEMBLGetDrugInfoArgs), ClinicalTrialsTool.VALID_STATUSES / VALID_PHASES, and the product contract (docs/v2/PHASE3_ORCHESTRATION_CONTRACT.md, docs/v2/PHASE3_GATE_PLAN.md) -- NOT by asking an LLM 'what's the right answer' and trusting it. An LLM was not used to author or verify any gold label in this file; query text was authored directly using well-established public biomedical facts (real drug/target/indication pairings and real ChEMBL IDs such as CHEMBL941=imatinib, CHEMBL25=aspirin) for realism only -- the gold label under test is the orchestration decision (source/operation/parameter selection, schema validity, abstention), never the biomedical fact itself. Each case's `gold_label_rationale` field states the specific tool-signature or contract clause the label is derived from, so every label is independently auditable against the cited source file/line.

phase2_consumed_test_split.note: This is the 105-example held-out set referenced in docs/v2/PHASE2_CLOSURE_REPORT.md and docs/v2/BENCHMARK_PLAN.md, consumed by the original Phase 2 pass. This file's top-level metadata was inspected only to confirm its identity/location so it could be avoided; no case content, query text, or gold label from it was read, copied, or reused anywhere in this benchmark.
